creative_brief.emotional_promise: Flick a tiny seed, watch it turn on its belly, and feel it knock home on the same face.
creative_brief.format_rationale: One printed piece with no assembly or rules fits a double-sided owner card: promise and inventory on the front, the three-beat play cycle on the back.
creative_brief.physical_format: 7.5 by 5 inch landscape two-sided owner card
teaching_arc: See the seed and what arrives
Set the flat face on a table
Flick the equator so it spins on its belly
Let the same face knock home
creative_brief.visual_motif: Exact seed renders in rounded panels, a seed-ring lockup in the title, and table-line state frames for rest, spin, and knock.

findings: On the first back, FACE DOWN / FLICK AND SPIN / KNOCK HOME captions sat under empty cream while the three seeds clustered in the center, so the signature cycle was named but not shown under its labels.
resolved_changes: Split the play strip into three equal panels with each seed under its caption, a table line, a spin arrow on flick, knock marks on settle, and renamed the third step Knock to match the strip.
